_meta.min_python_files_rationale: Floor for operator-visible quality guard; the canonical module presence is enforced by required_files (which fires critical_drift on missing modules). This threshold exists as a quality floor — not a hard fail — so slim test/build fixtures can pass while still catching structural truncation on the real repo baseline.
_meta.rationale_audience: operator + downstream validator authors; safe to ignore top-level _meta fields by strict JSON-Schema parsers (nesting convention per draft-07)
_meta.path_a_allowlist_rationale: Path A (thinker round 8 verdict): narrow allowlist to ONLY docs/tests/configs. Canonical control_plane/ and bin/ files remain enforced strictly via required_paths anchors (which fire critical_drift). Wildcards ^control_plane/.*\.py$ and ^bin/.*\.(py|sh)$ were removed to prevent silently suppressing unexpected additions (e.g. malicious_override.py inserted into a canonical dir) — the gate must surface that as general_drift for operator review.

thresholds.exit_code_1: general_drift (operator block; supernumerary files not in schema OR min_python_files below threshold OR forbidden paths detected)
thresholds.exit_code_2: critical_drift (Heimdall veto; missing core control_plane / pyproject)
thresholds.exit_code_3: bootstrap_drift (.env.appwrite.example present but .env.appwrite missing; manual re-bootstrap required)
